events.title: Henry of Anjou marries Eleanor of Aquitaine
events.description: Henry of Anjou, the future Henry II of England, married Eleanor of Aquitaine after the annulment of her marriage to King Louis VII of France. She brought Aquitaine into the Angevin Empire, and Henry became king two years later.
events.html: Henry of Anjou, the future Henry II of England, married Eleanor of Aquitaine after the annulment of her marriage to King Louis VII of France. She brought Aquitaine into the Angevin Empire, and Henry became king two years later.

events.title: Mamluks capture Acre, the last great crusader city
events.description: Sultan al-Ashraf Khalil's army stormed Acre after a six-week siege. The remaining crusader towns on the coast were abandoned within months, ending the crusader states in the Levant.
events.html: Sultan al-Ashraf Khalil's army stormed Acre after a six-week siege. The remaining crusader towns on the coast were abandoned within months, ending the crusader states in the Levant.

events.title: Flemish townsmen massacre the French garrison in Bruges
events.description: Before dawn, Flemish townsmen led by Pieter de Coninck and Jan Breydel massacred the French garrison installed in Bruges by Philip IV of France. The revolt led to the Flemish victory at the Battle of the Golden Spurs in July.

events.title: Ming general Lan Yu routs the Northern Yuan at Buyur Lake
events.description: A Ming army under Lan Yu surprised the camp of the Northern Yuan khan Toghus Temür near Lake Buir, capturing tens of thousands of people. The khan escaped but was soon killed by a rival, and Northern Yuan authority collapsed.

events.title: French Senate proclaims Napoleon Emperor of the French
events.description: A decree of the Senate made First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte hereditary emperor. He crowned himself in Notre-Dame in December, in the presence of Pope Pius VII.
events.html: A decree of the Senate made First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte hereditary emperor. He crowned himself in Notre-Dame in December, in the presence of Pope Pius VII.

events.title: Republicans nominate Abraham Lincoln for president
events.description: At the Chicago convention Lincoln overtook the favourite, William Seward, on the third ballot. His election in November prompted Southern states to secede.
events.html: At the Chicago convention Lincoln overtook the favourite, William Seward, on the third ballot. His election in November prompted Southern states to secede.

events.title: Plessy v. Ferguson upholds 'separate but equal'
events.description: The US Supreme Court ruled that racial segregation on Louisiana railways did not violate the Constitution. The decision underpinned Jim Crow laws until Brown v. Board of Education in 1954.
events.html: The US Supreme Court ruled that racial segregation on Louisiana railways did not violate the Constitution. The decision underpinned Jim Crow laws until Brown v. Board of Education in 1954.

events.title: Mount St Helens erupts in Washington State
events.description: An earthquake triggered a vast landslide and lateral blast that tore away the mountain's north face. Fifty-seven people died in the deadliest eruption in US history.
events.html: An earthquake triggered a vast landslide and lateral blast that tore away the mountain's north face. Fifty-seven people died in the deadliest eruption in US history.
